app_name: LOKAL MILITAR - Fardas e Artigos Militares

typography.rules: Headings must be robust and authoritative (Chivo, tracking-tight, uppercase for sections). Data tables, SKUs, Order Numbers, and prices MUST use IBM Plex Mono for tactical precision. Do NOT use Inter for headings.

colors.rules: Tactical Military palette. Use Olive Green (#4B5320) for primary actions, Khaki (#C3B091) for secondary borders/surfaces, Gold (#B8860B) strictly for highlights, alerts, or ranks. STRICTLY NO purple gradients. Dark elements should map to #111111. Ensure contrast is high.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Tactical Minimalism. Heavy use of 1px solid borders (border-collapse on tables, border-border/40). Avoid soft, bubbly shadows. Use crisp geometric containers. Modals and cards should feel like rugged command-center panels.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Strictly limited to rounded-none or rounded-sm (max 4px) to preserve the 'indestructible' military hardware feel.
visual_enhancers.effects: Use subtle grid line backgrounds or crosshair accents in empty states.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard: High-Density Grid. 4 KPI cards (Fardamento, Calçados, Acessórios, Insígnias) that are clickable with sharp hover interactions. Filterable chart spans multiple columns. Tight gaps (gap-4).
grids_and_layouts.sidebar: Strong military-themed collapsible sidebar. Deep black or olive dark background. High-contrast icons. Active states highlight with Olive Green or Gold.
grids_and_layouts.tables: Dense data tables. Use monospace for numeric/SKU columns. Clear visual hierarchy with sticky headers and inline actions.

motion.interactions: Fast, crisp micro-interactions. Hover states should feel like tactical target locks (e.g., sharp 1px border highlights, subtle background shifts). No slow or bouncy animations.
motion.modals: Use Shadcn Sheet component (slide-in from right) for large forms. Make them wide (w-3/4 or w-full on mobile).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over Olive Green meets APCA/WCAG standards (typically requires white text).
accessibility.focus: Focus rings should be sharp 2px solid Gold (#B8860B) or Olive Green (#4B5320).

login_background.description: Tactical gear/soldiers in camouflage. Use with heavy dark or olive overlay (bg-black/70) so the login form is readable.

instructions_to_main_agent.global_logic: Build a robust React + Tailwind ERP system with a military theme. Implement a React Context or similar global state for the background theme so the Color Picker in Configurações instantly applies one of the 6 background colors to the app.

modules.name: Dashboard
modules.details: Name exactly 'Dashboard'. Display 4 clickable metric cards (Fardamento, Calçados, Acessórios, Insígnias) and a filterable sales chart.

modules.name: Produtos
modules.details: List and creation form with military size grid (P/M/G/GG/XGG + 38-46), SKU, Categoria, and Photo upload. Use large Sheet component for editing.

modules.name: Estoque
modules.details: Track Entrada/Saída with a detailed history log. Use dense table layout.

modules.name: Pedidos
modules.details: Order management. MUST feature 3 distinct print/export buttons: A4 Fiscal, Thermal 80mm, Save PDF. Create dedicated printable components.

modules.name: Print_A4_Layout
modules.details: Strict fiscal layout matching reference. Top-left: LOKAL MILITAR logo. Top-right: CNPJ/Address. Center: Pedido # (large). Table: QTD, Produto, Tamanho, VL Unit, Subtotal. Bottom-right: Totals. Bottom: Observations, Client info (Patente/OM), and Signature line.

modules.name: Trocas e Devoluções
modules.details: Module for returns, allowing entries even without an original order number (avulsa).

modules.name: Clientes
modules.details: Military client fields: Nome/Loja, Patente/OM, CPF, Telefone, Endereço.

modules.name: Comissões
modules.details: Name exactly 'Comissões'. Track and calculate R$1/item sold per vendedor.

modules.name: Gastos
modules.details: Divided into distinct sub-modules or tabs: 'Insumos', 'Viagens' (tracking Combustível, Pedágios), 'Manutenção Veículo'.

modules.name: Categorias
modules.details: Dynamic CRUD for categories. Allow assigning colors or icons.

modules.name: Kits/Conjuntos
modules.details: Special logic requirement: If a kit 'FARDA' is added to an order, it must automatically disassemble (desmontagem automática) into 'CALÇA' + 'GANDOLA' of the exact same size in the order items.

modules.name: Configurações
modules.details: Settings page. Must include a Color Picker with the 6 specific colors requested to change the app's global background.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this. Make the frontend distinctly military and tactical.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep shapes sharp (no bubbly shadows).
MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions.
MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use sharp or very slightly rounded modern buttons (no fully pill-shaped generic buttons for a military app).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='print-a4').
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, active states.
CRITICAL: Do NOT use fully transparent backgrounds in headers or dropdowns. Use solid backgrounds.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
